title: Common-stage pullback object representation
statement: For a scheme map $k:V\to W$ (residue fields inverting $\ell$) and a common-stage object $M=(E,K)$ over $W$, the selected common-stage pullback sends $M$ literally to the pair $(E,k^*_E K)$ of the same stage, with $k^*_E$ the rational derived pullback at stage $E$.

proof.text: This is the object clause of the defining existence-and-uniqueness statement of common-stage pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], applied to the chosen functor.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageDerivedPullback_object_representation
    {V W : Scheme.{u}} (k : V ⟶ W)
    [∀ v : V, Invertible (l : V.residueField v)]
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
    (M : generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω W) :
    (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω k).obj M = commonStagePullbackObject l Ω k M
